subject: mitosis

composition.story: Mitosis replicates a cell into two identical daughter nuclei through distinct chromosomal phases.

aha.observation: Sister chromatids pull apart toward opposite poles.

states.label: Prophase
states.sentence: Chromatin condenses into visible chromosomes inside the nucleus.
states.why: DNA packs tightly for safe movement.

states.label: Metaphase
states.sentence: Chromosomes line up along the cell equator.

states.label: Anaphase
states.sentence: Sister chromatids pull apart toward opposite poles.

states.label: Telophase
states.sentence: Two new nuclear envelopes form around the separated sets.
